articles.title: Anthropic opens Claude Duet preview for US Pro and Max users
앤트로픽, 메타 '뮤즈' 대항마 AI 에이전트 '클로드 듀엣' 공개

facts.fact: Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet, a proactive agent that surfaces work needing attention, carries out assigned tasks in the background, and asks before acting on a user's behalf.
Access is by waitlist for US Claude Pro and Max subscribers; it is included in those plans and shares their existing usage limits.
Duet is built around Claude Opus 5.5 and runs as a standalone app on iOS and Android and on the Claude website.
It sends a concise morning brief based on connected apps and checks those accounts every few hours.
It can use more than 6,000 connectors and plugins in the Claude Marketplace, including Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, Stripe, HubSpot and Shopify.
Duet must show the proposed action and wait before sending a message, making a payment, signing a document, or deleting anything; securities trading and transfers between accounts remain prohibited.
The preview remains limited: Duet may misread threads or rank urgency poorly, and users cannot yet view its browser.
A virtual machine with its own browser keeps working when the user's devices are off.
AI Times reports Duet competes with Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots, and says Duet's difference is that it periodically checks business accounts and flags what needs attention before the user asks.

candidates.title: Meta says its Muse AI agent has passed 10 million users, with shopping a top activity

articles.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity

facts.fact: Meta said on its third-quarter earnings call that its AI app Muse has been adopted by more than 10 million users.
Mark Zuckerberg said about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily.
Over a quarter of Muse's engaged users who were shopping via the AI agent had an average purchase size of over $200.
Muse uses Plaid's connector, a fintech company that links payment apps to bank accounts, to enable agentic shopping.
Meta intends to keep Muse free for most users while keeping a percentage of commerce on the platform; power users who want advanced models or more tokens will pay.
Zuckerberg said Meta is building capacity to serve more than a billion people over the next few years and expects to improve Muse's cost efficiency by more than 10x in the next year.
Zuckerberg teased a 'Muse network' where 'your Muses can work with your friends' and your families' [Muses]'.
Reality Labs losses are expected to improve from $19.1 billion in 2025 to $15 billion this year.

articles.title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google's Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
웹사이트 70% 쓰는 PHP서 AI가 결함 발견…각국 정부 사이트 중단

facts.fact: The US National Security Agency warned that two critical holes had been found in PHP, with patches already issued by the PHP Foundation.
PHP powers roughly 70% of the websites on the internet, by some accounts more than 33 million sites.
The holes have been in all versions of PHP since version 5, released in 2004.
Security firm Calif, working in OpenAI's 'Patch the Planet' initiative, found one flaw using GPT-5.6 Sol; Wiz used its AI agent, Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol to find multiple vulnerabilities.
The NSA's guidance is that a PHP site that cannot be patched right away should be pulled offline until it can be.
Wiz warned: 'With AI this is no longer a barrier. LLMs can help adapt an exploit to different PHP versions, configurations and memory layouts.'
OpenAI says the flaws were found by researchers before hackers, and there were no reports of exploits in the wild.

In the Netherlands, government portals, the Port of Rotterdam, the football association, major political parties and several hospitals took public websites offline; Germany's University of Freiburg, Austria's University of Vienna, the Wikimedia Foundation and the Internet Archive also paused some sites or systems.
Wiz said one researcher finished in a week what a world-class team would have needed months for; the two flaws are called 'PHP2Shell' and each scored 9.2 out of 10 for severity.
Censys observed about 2.6 million hosts, of which 1.5 million ran PHP versions that cannot easily receive the fix.

facts.fact: OpenAI and Google announced on Oct. 21 (US time) that OpenAI's frontier models and the coding agent Codex will come to Google Cloud's Model Garden.
A private preview has started for some enterprise customers, with general availability planned within weeks.
Initial models are GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.
Companies can buy OpenAI models in the Google Cloud Marketplace and count the spend toward their existing Google Cloud commitments, on a single Google Cloud bill.
Google says it does not use customers' inputs and outputs to train foundation models.
OpenAI now sells through Microsoft, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud; it moved to AWS after Microsoft's exclusive distribution ended in April.
Google says it is the only large cloud offering the closed models of all three leading labs: Gemini, Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI.

candidates.title: South Korea's antitrust watchdog drafts rules against 'AI washing' in product ads
candidates.notes: Korea angle. Yonhap original returned 403; Korea Times and JoongAng Daily (Yonhap wire) read in full.

articles.title: FTC to collect public opinion on draft guidelines against 'AI washing'
FTC to collect public opinion on draft guidelines against 'AI washing'

facts.fact: Korea's Fair Trade Commission began collecting public opinion on Thursday on draft guidelines against advertisements exaggerating products' use of AI, known as 'AI washing'; the consultation runs through Nov. 11.
The FTC said the term AI leads consumers to perceive performance and reliability as relatively superior or to be willing to pay extra.
Examples of products marketed as AI products included electric hot-water heating mats, cat litter boxes, pillows and weight-control shakes.
The guidelines cover four major categories of potential violations of the Act on Fair Labeling and Advertising.
They include a self-assessment checklist and frequently asked questions for businesses.
The FTC also raised concerns about AI tools generating virtual people and fabricated reviews to promote food and pharmaceutical products to older consumers.
The guidelines are not legally binding but are meant to help businesses prevent violations and promote fair competition in AI-related markets.

articles.title: Dutch photonics startup Photon Bridge raises €10M to tackle AI's looming laser bottleneck
Photon Bridge raises €10M to mass-produce lasers for AI data centres

facts.fact: Dutch photonics company Photon Bridge raised €10 million to tackle a bottleneck in AI infrastructure: producing the millions of lasers needed to connect large clusters of AI processors.
The round was co-led by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund and 360 Capital, with existing investors Innovation Industries, Faber and the Brabant Development Agency (BOM) increasing their investment.
Omdia forecasts that more than 20 million data-centre AI accelerators will ship annually by 2028.
Instead of one very powerful laser, Photon Bridge combines light from several lower-power lasers; weaker lasers are less sensitive to manufacturing defects, improving yield.
The design targets up to 40 mW of optical power per wavelength per fibre.
First samples are planned for 2027 and volume manufacturing from 2028; the team in Eindhoven will expand.
Photon Bridge was called Photon IP until last year, when it raised €4.75M in seed funding; it does not run its own factory.
Nvidia has put at least $6.5B into photonics firms since March, according to TNW.

candidates.title: Walmart opens its stores to AI shopping agents with an Agent Gateway while Amazon blocks them
candidates.notes: Verge and Reuters versions not readable. Pairs with the Muse story (Walmart is a Muse partner).

articles.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat

facts.fact: Walmart launched its own Agent Gateway, an MCP server designed to help approved AI agents connect to Walmart and make purchases for users, for Walmart and Sam's Club.
The announcement came shortly after Amazon began blocking AI agents from making purchases for shoppers.
Walmart had already announced a partnership with Meta's Muse and offers integrations with ChatGPT, Gemini and others.
With Agent Profiles, rolling out next month, customers authorize each AI agent with a dedicated profile so its purchases show separately.
Customers can require approval for each transaction or authorize purchases within a spending limit they set.
Walmart says its returns process applies even when an agent does not act as intended.
Walmart says agents cannot access customers' payment information, and agents that do not comply with its terms will be blocked.
MCP, the model context protocol, was originally created by Anthropic.

candidates.title: SK Telecom teams with Korean mathematicians to strengthen its A.X K2 model's math reasoning

articles.title: SKT, 오픈AI 이어 '수학 난제' 도전...독파모 수학 추론 역량 키운다

facts.fact: SK Telecom said on the 22nd it will strengthen the math reasoning of its own foundation model A.X K2 together with Korean math and AI researchers.
Researchers joining include professors from Seoul National University, the Korea Institute for Advanced Study (KIAS) and KAIST.
SKT will reflect mathematicians' expertise in model training and use the resulting reasoning to improve agentic AI.
It plans to extend the work to research on 'recursive self-improvement (RSI)', where AI improves its own abilities.
The article notes OpenAI recently drew attention by solving more than 300 unsolved math problems.

facts.fact: NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference.
In tests on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems, Nscale said NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS enabled 37% more GPUs and nearly 50% higher aggregate inference throughput within the same power budget.
Mistral is expanding its NVIDIA infrastructure, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure planned for delivery in 2027.
Mistral Large 4 was trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral-operated European data centers.

Baseten and CodeRabbit improved code-review routing agreement from 75.8% to 80.7% while reducing estimated inference costs by 50% on the evaluated workload.
